description: This PHP file contains unit tests for the EmployeeEducationAPI class within the OrangeHRM project. It tests CRUD functionalities, validation rules, and service interactions related to employee education records in the HRM system.

classes.name: EmployeeEducationAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that verifies the correct behavior of the EmployeeEducationAPI, including CRUD operations, validation rules, and service interactions.

methods.name: loadFixtures
methods.description: Loads fixture data into the database for testing purposes.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeEducationService
methods.description: Tests that the API correctly provides an instance of EmployeeEducationService.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single employee education record by ID.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validates the API's validation rules for retrieving one employee education record.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an employee education record.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validates the API's validation rules for updating records.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deleting an employee education record.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validates the validation rules for deleting records.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creating a new employee education record.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Validates the API's validation rules for creating records.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieving all education records for an employee.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Validates the validation rules for retrieving all records.
